dog.description_text:
Cashe arrived at MACC as a stray with no known history. While in care, Cashe has been observed to balk while on leash and needed to be picked up to be brought to his assessment. While on the street, Cashe was observed to balk repeatedly and balked when a car passed by. Due to the detailed behavior, we recommend an experienced adult only home.

My Boroughbreaker writes: At just 1 year old, Cache is a sweet, energetic little guy with a heart full of love and the most adorable zoomies! 💕I throughly enjoyed our time together and he's so precious!!! He loves to explore his surroundings, discover new things, and soak up every bit of attention he can get. And those gentle little treat-taking manners? Absolutely adorable! 🥹Cache is ready to leave shelter life behind and show the world his true, amazing colors. He deserves a safe, loving home where he can grow, play, explore, and shower his family with all the love he has to give. Could you be the person who gives Cache his happily-ever-after? ❤️🐶

My Boroughbreaker writes: I noticed when we walked past dogs he didn't care for small ones. Also it looked like he had an ear infection. He seemed decently lease trained he wanted to walk ahead but you could keep him by your side and he wouldn't mind. He likes being in crevices. He was potty trained and knew how to sit for treats already
dog.name: Cache
